scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,ops,field -c magenta,blue,green "pnpm dev:api" "pnpm dev:ops" "pnpm dev:field"
scripts.dev:api: cd services/backend && uv run uvicorn app.main:app --reload --port 8787
scripts.test:unit: pnpm test:web && pnpm test:backend && pnpm test:tile
scripts.test:contracts: pnpm test:scripts && pnpm fixtures:validate && pnpm api:source-check && pnpm api:check
scripts.lint: pnpm -r --if-present lint && pnpm lint:backend && pnpm lint:tile
scripts.lint:backend: cd services/backend && uv run ruff check .
scripts.lint:tile: cd services/tile-api && uv run ruff check .
scripts.format:check: pnpm -r --if-present format:check && pnpm format:backend && pnpm format:tile
scripts.format:backend: cd services/backend && uv run ruff format --check .
scripts.format:tile: cd services/tile-api && uv run ruff format --check .
scripts.api:generate: cd services/backend && uv run python ../../scripts/export_openapi.py && cd ../.. && pnpm --filter @floodrise/api-client generate
scripts.seed: cd services/backend && uv run python -m app.seed
